_comment: The license texts and notices that Cubiq ships in licenses/third-party/ for code of other projects whose own files do not carry them all: bundled libraries whose jars contain no license or notice file, libraries whose jars lack notices or do not say where their source code is (noticesInJar), and, under "embedded", code compiled into the server jar or the Paperclip jar itself. Every file was fetched from the source recorded under "files": a commit of a repository, or a URL for two projects without a license file of their own. scripts/library-licenses.py checks that each bundled library without notices in its jar is covered at its bundled version and that the files are unchanged. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md for how to update an entry.

The Linux velocity-cipher libraries link the system's OpenSSL (libcrypto) dynamically, and the macOS one uses CommonCrypto from macOS; none of them contains OpenSSL code.

The async-profiler native libraries contain async-profiler 4.5 (Apache-2.0); the Linux ones link libstdc++ and libgcc statically, under the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1, and the red-black tree and other STL code of libstdc++ in them carries the permission notices of Hewlett-Packard (1994) and Silicon Graphics (1996, 1997), which gcc-7.5.0/tree.cc contains. spark's TPS calculation is taken from Paper under the MIT license (Paper-MIT.md).

Brigadier.note: Paper patches seven source files of Brigadier, the command library of Minecraft 26.3, which uses version 1.3.11, and compiles them into the server jar. Mojang publishes Brigadier's source code under the MIT license without tags for its versions, so the license file is taken from the latest commit (version line 1.3). Brigadier's jar, which Paperclip takes from Mojang's server jar, contains no license file.

copyright: Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
DataFixerUpper.note: Paper patches three source files of DataFixerUpper, a library of Minecraft 26.3, which uses version 10.0.21, and compiles them into the server jar. Mojang publishes DataFixerUpper's source code under the MIT license without tags for its versions, so the license file is taken from the latest commit (version line 11.0). DataFixerUpper's jar, which Paperclip takes from Mojang's server jar, contains no license file.

JLine.note: Paper patches JLine's ShutdownHooks and compiles it into the server jar, where it replaces the class of jline-terminal 4.4.6.

Apache Log4j Core.note: Paper's feature patch "Add explicit flush support to Log4j AsyncAppender" compiles modified copies of Log4j's AsyncAppender and AsyncAppenderEventDispatcher into the server jar. Log4j itself is one of the libraries that Paperclip takes from Mojang's server jar.

Alternate Current.note: Paper's feature patch "Add Alternate Current redstone implementation", written by Alternate Current's author, compiles its redstone implementation (package alternate.current.wire) into the server jar and records that it was originally licensed under the MIT license.

Apache Commons Compress.note: Paperclip contains Commons Compress 1.5, relocated. Paperclip's build adds its license text to the Paperclip jar as commons-compress-LICENSE.txt, but not its NOTICE file.
